```yaml
name: Analyze

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      runner_os:
        description: 'Runner OS'
        required: true
        type: string
    outputs:
      sarif_id:
        description: 'SARIF ID'
        value: ${{ steps.codeql-analysis.outputs.sarif-id }}
      sarif_output:
        description: 'SARIF Output'
        value: ${{ steps.codeql-analysis.outputs.sarif-output }}

jobs:
  analyze:
    runs-on: ${{ inputs.runner_os }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up .NET Core SDK
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v2
        with:
          dotnet-version: '6.0'

      - name: Initialize CodeQL
        uses: github/codeql-action/init@v3
        with:
          languages: csharp
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Autobuild
        uses: github/codeql-action/autobuild@v3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          matrix: |
            { "language": "csharp", "os": "${{ inputs.runner_os }}" }
          working-directory: .

      - name: Perform CodeQL Analysis
        id: codeql-analysis
        uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          upload: true
          cleanup-level: full
          ram: 4GB
          checkout_path: .
          ref: ${{ github.ref }}
          sha: ${{ github.sha }}
          category: security
          upload-database: true
          post-processed-sarif-path: results.sarif
          wait-for-processing: false

      - name: Set SARIF ID and Output
        run: |
          echo "::set-output name=sarif_id::${{ steps.codeql-analysis.outputs.sarif-id }}"
          echo "::set-output name=sarif_output::${{ steps.codeql-analysis.outputs.sarif-output }}"
```
